summary: RPM International filed a Form 8-K reporting the results of its October 8, 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders and a quarterly dividend increase. All twelve director nominees were elected, with Julie A. Beck receiving the lowest support at roughly 97.2 million votes for versus 7.0 million withheld, a notable dissent level. Say-on-pay passed with about 96.5 million for and 7.3 million against, and Deloitte Touche LLP was ratified as auditor for fiscal 2027. Separately, RPM announced an increased quarterly cash dividend via press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1. No special-situation transaction is present; watch for governance or capital-return signals.
